pose_validation.measurement_space: Actor root local units (root scale removed); example points use original Three +Y up/+X forward axes.
pose_validation.geometry_scope: Exact noncoplanar edge/triangle surface crossings at first/middle/last sample per phase and every release. Excludes intentional hand contact; not a swept collision, containment, coplanar overlap or complete gait proof.
pose_validation.scope: Actual anchor, nearest hand/weapon surface, rod endpoint, event and head-direction checks. Visual wrapping and armor intersection are separate acceptance items.
